title: Refined Swords
description: A vanilla-friendly resource pack that gives Minecraft swords a cleaner, sharper, and more polished appearance while keeping the original style of the game.
body:
# ⚔️ Resource Pack Description

A vanilla-friendly resource pack that enhances all Minecraft swords with a **cleaner, sharper, and more polished look** while staying true to the original game style.

Each blade is subtly refined to feel more detailed and satisfying without changing Minecraft’s classic aesthetic.

## ✨ Features
- Cleaner and sharper sword designs  
- Vanilla-style friendly textures  
- Lightweight and performance-friendly  
- Simple yet modern visual upgrade  

Perfect for players who want a **smoother and more polished look** without losing the original Minecraft feel.
